neighbours.label: Opaque letter-code strings where the next letters are predictable: mid-alphabet runs inside a string literal (…HI|JKLMNOP|QRST…) and the article-ID slug after an Oxford 10.1093 DOI journal code ('/k'fs…, '/d'k…, '/l'fr…); ordinary strings and other DOIs stay quiet

notes: Card: 'JKLMNOP' x3, '/k' x3, '/d' x2, 'dk' x2, '/l', 'FH', 'JKLM'. Probes: 'DEFGHIJKLMNOP' 0.80, 10.1093/jxb/kru044 0.41, but the full 'ABCDEF…XYZ' right after a quote only 0.09 (tokenised differently), so the alphabet items start mid-alphabet or after a space. A list of two string kinds; I could not test a shared pattern beyond 'predictable letter code'.
